label: Bible Study
prompt: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is _____ of all.
verse: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
note: Break one link and the whole chain is broken — James on keeping the law.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I am the _____: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verse: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
note: Jesus calls Himself the door: come in, go out, find pasture — sheep life at its safest and best.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Moreover his mother made him a little _____, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verse: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
note: Every year Hannah made young Samuel a little coat and brought it when she came up to the yearly sacrifice.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And let us consider one another to _____ unto love and to good works:
verse: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
note: The one good kind of provoking — church as a place where people stir each other up to love and good works.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Beware lest any man spoil you through _____ and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verse: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
note: Paul's warning to Colossae: don't let anyone 'spoil' you — carry you off as plunder — through hollow philosophy.
